data.title: GenAI-Enhanced APP Fraud — Escalating Investment Payments to New Beneficiary
data.description: Detects the characteristic authorized push payment (APP) pattern associated with GenAI- enhanced investment fraud (pig butchering). The rule identifies customers making increasing payments to a newly added beneficiary with investment-related payment references, where payment velocity accelerates over a multi-week period. This pattern reflects the classic fattening-then-slaughter cycle: victims are groomed through AI-powered financial advisor personas and deepfake celebrity endorsements, make a small initial investment, see fabricated returns on fraudulent trading dashboards, and are progressively encouraged to invest larger amounts. The FBI IC3 reported $6.57 billion in investment fraud losses in 2024 — the single largest fraud category. Chainalysis research shows AI-enabled investment scams extract 4.5x more revenue per operation ($3.2M average) compared to non-AI variants ($719K average). The rule targets the execution phase (P4) where escalating authorized payments represent the point of maximum financial exposure before funds are laundered through cryptocurrency mixing, DeFi protocols, or mule networks.

detection.condition: selection AND filter_new_beneficiary AND filter_investment_reference AND filter_escalating_amount AND filter_velocity_acceleration

enrichment_required.source: Current payment amount as percentage increase over first payment to same beneficiary
Boolean — whether the gap between consecutive payments to the beneficiary is shrinking
Consortium fraud intelligence or regulatory warning list match on beneficiary account

queries.cql:
// CrowdStrike CQL for GenAI-Enhanced APP Fraud — Investment Variant
// Detects escalating payments to new beneficiary with investment references
(transaction_type="wire_transfer" OR transaction_type="faster_payment" OR transaction_type="ach_credit" OR transaction_type="sepa_credit" OR transaction_type="crypto_purchase")
beneficiary_relationship_days<60
payment_reference=/invest|trading|platform|portfolio|return|crypto|bitcoin|forex|yield|fund|capital|broker/i
payment_amount_increase_pct_vs_first>=200
inter_payment_interval_decreasing="true"
| cumulative_amount := sum(transaction_amount)
| payment_count := count(transaction_id)
| groupBy([customer_id, beneficiary_id], function=[
    collect([transaction_id, transaction_amount, transaction_date,
             beneficiary_name, payment_reference, payment_channel,
             beneficiary_relationship_days]),
    sum(transaction_amount, as=cumulative_amount),
    count(transaction_id, as=total_payments)
  ])
| sort(cumulative_amount, order=desc)
queries.splunk:
`comment("Splunk SPL for GenAI-Enhanced APP Fraud — Investment Variant")`
`comment("Detects escalating authorized push payments to new beneficiaries with investment references")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:transaction_monitoring
  (transaction_type="wire_transfer" OR transaction_type="faster_payment"
   OR transaction_type="ach_credit" OR transaction_type="sepa_credit"
   OR transaction_type="crypto_purchase")
| eval beneficiary_age_days = round((now() - strptime(beneficiary_added_date, "%Y-%m-%d")) / 86400)
| where beneficiary_age_days < 60
| regex payment_reference="(?i)(invest|trading|platform|portfolio|return|crypto|bitcoin|forex|yield|fund|capital|broker)"
| sort customer_id beneficiary_id _time
| streamstats count AS payment_seq first(transaction_amount) AS first_amount
    sum(transaction_amount) AS cumulative_amount
    range(_time) AS time_span
    BY customer_id, beneficiary_id
| eval amount_increase_pct = round(((transaction_amount - first_amount) / first_amount) * 100, 1)
| stats count AS total_payments sum(transaction_amount) AS total_amount
    first(transaction_amount) AS first_payment last(transaction_amount) AS latest_payment
    min(_time) AS first_date max(_time) AS last_date
    values(payment_reference) AS references
    BY customer_id, beneficiary_id, beneficiary_name
| eval escalation_ratio = round(latest_payment / first_payment, 1)
| eval days_span = round((last_date - first_date) / 86400)
| where total_payments >= 3 AND escalation_ratio >= 3
| eval risk_score = case(
    total_amount > 50000 AND escalation_ratio >= 5, "critical",
    total_amount > 20000 AND escalation_ratio >= 3, "high",
    escalation_ratio >= 3, "high",
    1=1, "medium")
| table customer_id, beneficiary_id, beneficiary_name, total_payments,
        first_payment, latest_payment, escalation_ratio, total_amount,
        days_span, references, risk_score
| sort - total_amount
queries.sql:
-- SQL for GenAI-Enhanced APP Fraud — Investment Variant
-- Detects escalating authorized push payments to new beneficiaries with investment references
WITH payment_sequence AS (
  SELECT
    t.customer_id,
    t.account_id,
    t.beneficiary_id,
    t.beneficiary_name,
    t.transaction_amount,
    t.transaction_date,
    t.payment_reference,
    t.payment_channel,
    DATEDIFF(DAY, b.beneficiary_added_date, t.transaction_date) AS beneficiary_age_days,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.customer_id, t.beneficiary_id ORDER BY t.transaction_date) AS payment_seq,
    FIRST_VALUE(t.transaction_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY t.customer_id, t.beneficiary_id ORDER BY t.transaction_date) AS first_payment_amount,
    LAG(t.transaction_date) OVER (PARTITION BY t.customer_id, t.beneficiary_id ORDER BY t.transaction_date) AS prev_payment_date
  FROM transactions t
  JOIN beneficiaries b ON t.beneficiary_id = b.beneficiary_id AND t.customer_id = b.customer_id
  WHERE t.transaction_type IN ('wire_transfer', 'faster_payment', 'ach_credit', 'sepa_credit', 'crypto_purchase')
    AND t.transaction_date >= DATEADD(DAY, -60, CURRENT_DATE)
    AND DATEDIFF(DAY, b.beneficiary_added_date, t.transaction_date) < 60
    AND t.payment_reference LIKE '%invest%'
     OR t.payment_reference LIKE '%trading%'
     OR t.payment_reference LIKE '%platform%'
     OR t.payment_reference LIKE '%crypto%'
     OR t.payment_reference LIKE '%bitcoin%'
     OR t.payment_reference LIKE '%forex%'
     OR t.payment_reference LIKE '%yield%'
     OR t.payment_reference LIKE '%fund%'
     OR t.payment_reference LIKE '%capital%'
     OR t.payment_reference LIKE '%broker%'
),
beneficiary_summary AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    beneficiary_id,
    beneficiary_name,
    COUNT(*) AS total_payments,
    SUM(transaction_amount) AS total_amount,
    MIN(transaction_amount) AS min_payment,
    MAX(transaction_amount) AS max_payment,
    MIN(transaction_date) AS first_payment_date,
    MAX(transaction_date) AS last_payment_date,
    DATEDIFF(DAY, MIN(transaction_date), MAX(transaction_date)) AS payment_span_days,
    MAX(transaction_amount) / NULLIF(MIN(transaction_amount), 0) AS escalation_ratio
  FROM payment_sequence
  GROUP BY customer_id, beneficiary_id, beneficiary_name
)
SELECT *
FROM beneficiary_summary
WHERE total_payments >= 3
  AND escalation_ratio >= 3
ORDER BY total_amount DESC

references: FBI IC3, 2024 Internet Crime Report — $6.57B investment fraud, $5.8B crypto investment fraud
Chainalysis, AI-Enabled Investment Scam Revenue Analysis — 4.5x revenue multiplier for AI-enhanced operations

FCA, Consumer Warning — Deepfake Celebrity Investment Scams
FinCEN, AML Advisory on Investment Scam Typologies
falsepositives: Legitimate staged investments in registered platforms (brokerage accounts, mutual funds) with increasing contributions
Business customers making scheduled investment-related payments to regulated financial institutions
Property investment installment payments with escalating milestone amounts
Cryptocurrency dollar-cost-averaging strategies with increasing position sizes
